persona.name: Grace Zhang
persona.language: English work records; Chinese UI labels
persona.background: Fictional architect who joined the South Studio of an international design practice on 1 October 2025, after four years at another practice. At Palm Tree everyone is new to her, so the archive starts with almost nobody; outside contacts may predate it, so first observed here is not always first met in life.
responsibilities: Competitions: floor plans and keeping the team on time
Project architect on the school and the office tower
Site work at the end of construction: builder's questions and defects
Small interior jobs: a clinic and a café
Helping the Hong Kong office for ten weeks
habits: Short end-of-day journal, about three a week
Weekly report to Dian on Fridays
Keeps the transmittal next to the drawing issue
Asks Siyi and the assistants for checks, not decisions
pain_points: Which drawing revision went out, and to whom
Why a design decision changed and who made it
Promises made by consultants in meetings
Spoken decisions that never reach email

manifest.signals_policy: connections.nodes[].signals are counts of records Grace has seen up to that day (by_channel adds an "assistant" count for AI-assistant outputs and omits channels with zero; shared_projects excludes studio operations). They are not a relationship score.
manifest.snapshot_policy: Snapshot nodes carry person_id, name, organisation_id, first_observed_at, source_ids and signals with zero counts omitted (the rest is in people[]). task_states keep open tasks, tasks completed in the last 10 days and their delegation chains; the full task list with history is top-level tasks[]. desk.decisions keep id, project_id, value, explanation, known_at, source_ids and is_current, for projects Grace works on or left / saw closed less than 30 days before; the full list is top-level decisions[]. desk.project_states carry id, status, phase, source_ids and (once closed) outcome; names and grace_periods are in projects[].
manifest.lifecycle_policy: projects[].status/outcome/closed_at are the state on the last day; desk.project_states[].status is "closed" only from closed_at and "on_hold" only from the pause notice; grace_periods say when Grace herself worked on a project (to: null = still on it).
manifest.focus_policy: desk.focus_project_id is the project with the highest weighted count of Grace's own calendar blocks, meetings, documents, messages and journal that day; carried over on days without project work; null on leave, weekends and closure days.
manifest.language_policy: English source bodies in plain language; Chinese and English labels for the UI.
manifest.channel_policy: Teams chat (1:1 and group), email, meetings, calendar and shared documents only.
manifest.milestone_policy: milestones[] are authored, dated project milestones (planned vs actual) traceable to source records; slipped ones keep both dates.
manifest.truth_boundary: All derived data, including work units and their statuses, is authored deterministic fixture output, not proof of a functioning AI extraction pipeline. Assistant records are authored in a machine style; no model was called.

records.title: How we issue drawings (one page)
records.body:
Drawing issue checklist
1. ModelCheck makes the register and the send-out list.

decisions.value: Fitline Interiors chosen as the builder
decisions.explanation: Lowest complete price and a ten-week schedule.

decisions.value: Clinic opens on 23 March
decisions.explanation: Ten weeks from the start on 19 January.

decisions.value: Clinic opening moved to 6 April (the X-ray room door is late)
decisions.explanation: The door supplier's delay; the practice manager prefers a full opening to opening without X-ray.

decisions.value: Add a small cooling unit in the X-ray room (approved as a change)
decisions.explanation: The clinic changed the X-ray machine after the price; its extra heat needs extra cooling.

decisions.value: A twisting tower: each floor turns slightly
decisions.explanation: Pai's choice at review 1, for the picture from the waterfront.

decisions.value: Two stepped towers joined by a sky lobby on level 20 (replaces the twisting tower)
decisions.explanation: Pai reversed his review 1 choice after the room count: 38 rooms with sloping walls and forty different floors.

decisions.value: Option B: 24 townhouses in two rows along a shared lane
decisions.explanation: The developer's choice for the study report.

decisions.value: Greenway decides not to buy the Elm Street land
decisions.explanation: Flood study and possible ground raising make the numbers too thin.

decisions.value: Option 2: a slim tower set back from the street with a tall glass lobby
decisions.explanation: Pai's choice: a small square on the street and a memorable lobby.

decisions.value: Overall design approved by Summit; Horizon Engineering appointed for the detailed design
decisions.explanation: Client board approval of the overall design report.

decisions.value: Option 3: emergency building on the staff car park, with a parking building first
decisions.explanation: Only option with a separate ambulance road; cheaper over both stages.

decisions.value: Work paused until the state confirms the funding (expected next year)
decisions.explanation: State moved the stage one funding to next year's budget.

decisions.value: Raise the building on columns so the public pier walk passes underneath
decisions.explanation: Pai's idea at the review: no detour for the public.

decisions.value: Counter along the left wall, seats by the window
decisions.explanation: Owner's choice: the queue is visible from the mall.

decisions.value: Shopping centre approves the café drawings for pricing
decisions.explanation: After the three comments were answered.

decisions.value: Craftfit Shopfitters chosen as the builder
decisions.explanation: The only builder able to finish before the 9 October opening.

decisions.value: Counter moves to the right wall, beside the water point
decisions.explanation: The coffee machine supplier wanted it near the water; the owner reversed his June choice.

decisions.value: Last two ground tests dropped; north foundation level (rock at an assumed 1.2 m) to be confirmed on site
decisions.explanation: The old shed could not be cleared before the drawings were finished; the builder confirms the level when digging.
